Spatial voice chat is built in, with per\u2011guest volume and mute and push\u2011to\u2011talk. The connection is direct and encrypted, and sharing does not affect your own performance.","w":["Top bar \u203a Share"],"n":"Hosting requires a licence \u00b7 viewing is free \u00b7 same Klay version on both sides \u00b7 save the scene before sharing"},{"g":"n","t":"Physical atmosphere","b":"The Sky is now computed from a physical atmosphere model (air, haze and ozone), so sky color and the key light stay consistent at every time of day. There is an 80% preset too"}],"windows":{"url":"https://github.com/c6ank/klay-releases/releases/download/0.0.43/Klay_Setup_0.0.43.exe","size":377229353,"sha512":"67cd87257438509935acc3f24ef2fff276bdeadb3df93eea309aacbef2cfb5044686ca64828f1ee9b509decc7cda043980ad60c57195a93a22abab26a35ebf9d"},"history":[{"version":"0.0.42","date":"2026-09-15","lede":"Hold N to drop a new clay layer right where your cursor points and drag it to the size you want, hold E to move, spin or scale the selection without leaving your tool, and a rotated clay layer's bounding box now turns with it.","highlights":["Hold N to place new clay","Hold E for a quick transform","Open a model straight from your files"],"notesUrl":"https://klaysculpt.com/releases/0.0.42","items":[{"g":"n","t":"Hold N to place new clay","b":"Hold N and the new empty clay layer rides your cursor, its centre snapping onto the surface under it (or staying at the same depth over empty space), and dragging with the left button while N is held sizes it, which also sets how fine its detail will be; a quick tap still adds the layer where it always did.","k":["Hold [N]","Hold [N] + left-drag to size"]},{"g":"n","t":"Hold E for a quick transform","b":"From any tool, hold E and drag with the left button to move the selection across the screen, the right button to spin it or the middle button to scale it, then let go of E to return to the tool you were on; a quick tap still switches to the Gizmo tool.","k":["Hold [E] + drag"]},{"g":"n","t":"Open a model straight from your files","b":"Open an OBJ, FBX, Alembic, glTF, PLY, DAE or STL file with Klay from Windows Explorer and it starts right on the Import dialog for that model, skipping the welcome screen; select several and they come in together with one size choice. Klay now appears in the \"Open with\" list for these files, without taking over the app they already open in.","w":["Explorer \u203a Open with","Klay"]},{"g":"i","t":"Blur, sharpen, expand and contract the mask from its card","b":"The Mask tool card has a Blur | Sharpen bar and an Expand | Contract bar: click a side for one step, or hold and drag to keep going, with Rectangle and Lasso buttons for the marquee above them and Invert / Erase as buttons below. Sharpen tightens a soft edge back onto its middle, as in ZBrush and Blender, and Expand / Contract move the mask's edge out or in while keeping its softness. A whole drag undoes in one Ctrl+Z.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Tool card","Mask"]},{"g":"i","t":"Pick any light from the Lantern","b":"The Lantern's tool card now lists every light in the scene at the top, with its colour, type, on/off eye and intensity, so you can switch to another light, recolour it from its swatch, add one or turn one off without leaving the tool; the light's type is one row of buttons under the list, its settings sit in one card below, and area lights gain Focus.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Tool card","Lantern"]},{"g":"i","t":"Laser settings in the tool card","b":"The Laser's floating bar is gone: its shapes and actions are now two rows of buttons at the top of the sidebar tool card (still there with the card closed, and holding Ctrl lights the action it swaps to), with depth, fill, flip, joint and stroke smoothing grouped underneath; a button that does nothing on the selected layer, like Create on a polygon mesh, is dimmed.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Tool card"],"k":["Laser [J]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Remesh and Boolean take layered meshes","b":"A mesh with sculpt layers or subdivision levels no longer blocks Remesh or Boolean: its layers are flattened into the level you are looking at and the operation just runs, and undoing a Remesh gives you the original back with its layers and levels.","w":["Outliner \u203a Right-click"],"k":["Remesh [Alt]+[R]"]},{"g":"i","t":"Set your own maximum brush size","b":"Every brush-size slider now ends in a small box showing its maximum: click it and type a bigger number to sculpt a large scene, or a smaller one to spend the whole slider on fine detail. Klay remembers it, and resizing the brush by dragging follows the same limit, in the tool card, the Brush panel, the Select tool and the radial menu.","w":["Sidebar \u203a Tool card","Size"]},{"g":"i","t":"Pen pressure drives smoothing, elastique and hardness","b":"Polygon brushes get three new pen sliders under Pressure \u2192 size: pressure can now control how much the brush smooths, how strong its Elastique pull is, and how hard its edge is, so a light touch can glide softly and a firm press brings the full effect.","w":["Brush panel \u203a Stroke","Pressure \u2192 smooth \u00b7 elastique \u00b7 hardness"]},{"g":"i","t":"PBR as fast as PBR Fast","b":"A PBR material now only pays for the effects it actually turns on: a plain one draws as fast as PBR Fast, and turning on GGX specular, clear coat, sheen or subsurface adds just that effect instead of slowing the object to about half the frame rate; one such material elsewhere in the scene no longer slows the others either.","w":["Material \u203a Shading model","PBR"]},{"g":"i","t":"Specular colour, right under Base colour","b":"Every material now has a Specular colour swatch just below Base colour, so you can tint its reflections without opening the Specular section, and it now works on PBR Fast too: a white swatch keeps PBR Fast exactly as fast as before, and a coloured one adds only that tint.","w":["Material \u203a Base colour","PBR Fast"]},{"g":"i","t":"Specular effects only cost what you turn on","b":"Turning on one Specular effect, such as Diffraction, Flakes or Retro-reflection, now adds just that effect to the object instead of switching the whole material to its heaviest look, so the frame rate barely moves in the viewport; RT likewise only prepares the effects your materials actually use, and gets them ready much sooner.","w":["Material \u203a Specular","PBR"]},{"g":"i","t":"Glass shows its far side","b":"A glass object in the viewport now shows its own back walls through the front, bent by the refraction and catching bright inner reflections at steep angles, so a glass cube reads as a solid block of glass instead of a window straight through to what is behind it, and it casts a lighter shadow that darkens as you raise the Tint and Thickness.","w":["Material \u203a Transmission"]},{"g":"i","t":"Press F over the outliner to find the selection","b":"With the pointer over the outliner, the Frame key now opens the folders and groups hiding the selected object and scrolls the list to it, instead of doing nothing; Rename in the right-click menu edits in place too, and double-clicking an object inside a folder renames the object; to select the whole folder, click the folder's own row.","w":["Outliner","Double-click"]},{"g":"f","t":"Pressure \u2192 size now works on polygon brushes: the brush size is the largest it gets, and a lighter touch draws smaller, instead of every stroke coming out at full size"},{"g":"f","t":"With symmetry on, masking a clay layer now masks both sides, and the Rectangle and Lasso masks mirror on every object, instead of masking only the side you drew on"},{"g":"f","t":"Isolate with several objects selected (the I key, the right-click menu or the eye button) now keeps all of them, instead of isolating just one and dropping the rest of the selection"},{"g":"f","t":"Duplicate X now mirrors every selected object, works on a duplicated mesh, and works on a mesh with subdivision levels without flattening it first (the copy keeps the level you are looking at); toggling a sculpt layer on the mirrored copy now stays mirrored too"},{"g":"f","t":"Turning on Transmission now makes an object see-through right away, showing the scene behind it, instead of only reflecting the sky until the scene was reopened"},{"g":"f","t":"A rotated clay layer's bounding box now turns with the layer, instead of staying upright and growing as you rotated it"},{"g":"f","t":"Dropping a .klay scene onto the window now opens it (asking to save your current scene first), instead of doing nothing"},{"g":"f","t":"Right-clicking the empty part of the Scene outliner now opens the same menu as right-clicking the empty viewport, instead of doing nothing"},{"g":"f","t":"Laser cuts on a polygon mesh now always fill the hole cleanly: no gaps along the seam, no starburst fills, and a cut that touches an earlier one fills too.
